en: The postcard features a black-and-white illustration or photograph of a historical European city street scene, with people, horse-drawn carriages, and classic buildings. Dominating the background is a large baroque-style church tower with a clock. The street scene shows people in 19th-century attire. On the main building in the right foreground, there is visible signage reading 'RUDOLF KRONHAUS.'
